# Plugin.Maui.AppLock

Application-security workflow for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. Locks the app after backgrounding, waits out a grace period, then unlocks with Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint, or the device PIN. Not another biometric API.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.AppLock
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppLock
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-app-lock
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 23+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppLock

Registration: `UseAppLock` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I lock a .NET MAUI app after it goes to the background?
- Face ID / Touch ID / fingerprint / device PIN unlock for the whole app
- App lock timer, then authenticate on resume
- `await AppLock.RequireAuthenticationAsync()` before a sensitive screen
- Banking / health / notes privacy lock in MAUI

## Do not use when

- The app only needs a one-shot biometric prompt
- The need is access-token lock / 401 refresh (use Plugin.Maui.SecureSession)
- The app only needs to know if biometric hardware exists (use Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus)
- Windows or Mac Catalyst is a required target
